capabilities: insert a LongtimeDiary code block into Daily notes
search Daily notes matching the same day of the month in previous years
display past entries inside the current Daily note
disambiguation: Not a diary-writing tool; it only displays past Daily notes on the same date, it does not create or manage entries.
extras: Not yet in the community plugin store; the README says installation is 'In the process of applying' and points early users to BRAT.
intentEvidence: helping you to look back on past on this day in the Daily note
motivation: The author calls it a must-have for long-time diary keepers on Obsidian who want to look back on past entries.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to surface past Daily notes on the same calendar date, so long-time diary keepers must search for them manually.
summary: On-this-day viewer that shows Daily notes from the same date in previous years inside a Daily note via a code block.
